title: post-apitrpcstoregetproducts-should-return-active-products
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/store.getProducts returns a 200 status with a list of active products when called with a valid request payload.

title: post-apitrpcstoreplaceorder-should-create-new-order
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/store.placeOrder creates a new order and returns a 200 status with order confirmation and order number when called with valid customer and cart details.

title: post-apitrpcstorecancelorder-should-cancel-order
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/store.cancelOrder cancels an order and returns a 200 status with cancellation confirmation when called with a valid order number and the order is in a cancelable state.

title: post-apitrpcstoregetorderbynumber-should-return-order-status
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/store.getOrderByNumber returns a 200 status with order status details when called with a valid order number.

title: post-apitrpcauthlogin-should-authenticate-admin
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/auth.login authenticates an admin and returns a 200 status with an authentication token or session context when called with valid admin credentials.

title: post-apitrpcadminlistorders-should-return-orders-with-auth
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/admin.listOrders returns a 200 status with a list of orders when called with valid authentication.

title: post-apitrpcadminupdateorderstatus-should-update-status
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus updates the order status and returns a 200 status with updated order details when called with valid authentication and valid order data.

title: post-apitrpcadmincreateproduct-should-create-product
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/admin.createProduct creates a new product and returns a 200 status with created product details when called with valid authentication and complete product data.

title: post-apitrpcadminupdateproduct-should-update-product
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/admin.updateProduct updates an existing product and returns a 200 status with updated product details when called with valid authentication and existing product data.

title: post-apitrpcadmindeleteorder-should-delete-order
description: Verify that POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteOrder deletes an existing order and returns a 200 status with deletion confirmation when called with valid authentication and existing order identifier.
